# Anuj Enterprises

> India's Leading B2B FMCG Distribution & Wholesale Sourcing Platform based in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.

Anuj Enterprises is a certified B2B FMCG wholesale distributor connecting retail kirana stores, supermarkets, institutional buyers, and bulk purchasers with authentic products from India's leading consumer brands (Amul, Nestlé, Britannia, Cadbury / Mondelez, Colgate, Hindustan Unilever, Parle, ITC, Dabur, and more).

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Direct Factory Procurement**: 100% genuine products directly sourced from verified brand manufacturers with full batch traceability.
- **Kanpur Central Distribution Hub**: Fast same-day / next-day order dispatch across Kanpur, Lucknow, Unnao, and Uttar Pradesh.
- **Flexible Kirana Packaging Hierarchy**: Granular packaging units supporting Unit (Piece, Gram, Litre, Bottle, Packet, Pouch), Pack, Bundle, Mala, Bori, Case, and Carton with exact piece counts.
- **Field Salesman Portal & Assisted Sourcing**: Dedicated field representatives conducting regular retail visits, stock replenishment, and personalized customer care.
- **Official B2B Invoicing**: Instant immutable product invoices with direct mandi settlement terms, downloadable PDF invoices, and 1-click WhatsApp sharing.
- **Customer Account Management**: Dedicated self-service customer portal with order tracking, reorder dockets, and scheduled delivery calendars.

## Key Product Portfolios

- **Dairy & Frozen**: Amul Butter, Ghee, Cheese, Fresh Cream, UHT Milk, Paneer, Nestlé Everyday Dairy Whitener, Condensed Milk.
- **Chocolates & Confectionery**: Cadbury Dairy Milk, 5 Star, Perk, Gems, Bournville, Celebrations Gift Boxes, Éclairs, Candies.
- **Biscuits & Cookies**: Britannia Good Day, Marie Gold, Bourbon, 50-50, Parle-G, Hide & Seek, Monaco, Sunfeast Dark Fantasy.
- **Personal Care & Hygiene**: Colgate Strong Teeth & MaxFresh Toothpaste, Dettol Soaps & Antiseptic, Dove & Lifebuoy Soaps, Head & Shoulders, Pantene.
- **Packaged Food & Staples**: Maggi 2-Minute Noodles, Kissan Tomato Ketchup & Jams, Tata Salt, Fortune Edible Oils, Aashirvaad Atta, Daawat Basmati Rice.
- **Home Care & Cleaning**: Surf Excel, Wheel, Rin Detergent Powders & Bars, Vim Dishwash, Harpic, Lizol Floor Cleaners.
- **Tea & Coffee**: Tata Tea Gold & Premium, Red Label, Taj Mahal, Nescafé Classic, BRU Instant Coffee.
